question.text: Applicable surcharge on Long-term Capital Gains (Section 112A) for HNI investor with LTCG > Rs. 2 crore is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 9.3.3 and 112A, surcharge on LTCG under Section 112A is capped at 15% regardless of income slab. The Trap: Higher surcharges apply to non-112A income only. Cross-Exam Context: Key tax planning point. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Maximize 112A-qualifying gains to exploit the 15% surcharge cap.
